title: Sleeper experiment cannot discriminate notice compliance from degenerate collapse policy
what_went_wrong: The V0.7-s sleeper experiment (80 runs, $3.99) produced recall 1.0 for all notice-visible arms on chain-01 and recall 0.0 for all arms on chain-02. Diagnosis of hop records showed every notice-visible arm (C, C-win, C-oc, P+FACTS) emits BUY qty=1 at every hop from hop 1 on BOTH chains. On chain-01 the override target L=1 coincides with the resulting state of that constant policy (position 1), so state-based classification scored PASS x240 -> recall 1.0. On chain-02 L=3 does not coincide (position 1 != 3), and even the P arm (which never receives the notice) emits BUY qty=1 x240 there because the base fair policy (base target 1) produces the identical action. The carrier arms behavior is indistinguishable from P on chain-02.
root_cause: The experiment design lacks discriminating power in the action space. The override instruction (set position_qty to L) maps to action+quantity pairs that coincide with plausible degenerate policies: on chain-01, compliance (BUY qty=1) is indistinguishable from a collapse/panic policy (BUY qty=1); on chain-02, base-policy-following (BUY qty=1, state-idempotent at base target 1) is indistinguishable from a constant policy. A clean test requires L and base values where compliance differs from BOTH the base fair policy AND any plausible collapse attractor (e.g., base=0/HOLD, L=2 -> compliance BUY qty=2 vs collapse BUY qty=1 vs base HOLD).
interim_conclusions_retracted: H1 (C-win window cliff) falsification - artifact of the chain-01 coincidence
H2 (C-oc compaction bimodality) not-materializing - untestable in this design
H4 (P+FACTS recall 1.00) confirmation - artifact on chain-01; chain-02 shows the carrier changed nothing observable
Transcripts self-document via reasoning echoes interpretation - unnecessary; behavior was a constant policy from hop 1, independent of notice visibility
what_survives: Token economics leg (T2 + this run): C 14.9x, C-win 5.47x, C-oc 4.51x, P+FACTS 1.13x vs P at h250 - replicated, valid
Harness gate battery: detector C CLEAN x16, positive controls OK, P inertness 16/16 - machinery worked as designed
P-arm schema-omission control: no carrier of the override -> 0.0 recall on both chains - the fact is lost without a delivery channel (clean, by design)
cost_of_failure: $3.99 of API spend produced no answer to the deferred-relevance question; ~15h wall time including a 6.3h provider storm
detection: Caught only in post-run diagnosis of the chain-01/chain-02 recall split; the chain-01 confound was invisible during earlier chain-01-only monitoring because the coincidence made results look clean
lesson: Before running sleeper/deferred-relevance experiments, verify that the compliant action is observably distinct from BOTH the base fair policy and plausible degenerate policies, in the actual action space, per chain. Dry-run the discrimination, not just the wiring.
